issues.description: The problem description (line ~50) instructs to implement addGuestStudents(String) but the UML, task list, and the solution implementation use addGuestStudents(int). This conflicting parameter type (String vs int) can confuse students about the correct method signature and lead to implementations that do not match the intended design or tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across artifacts. Update the problem statement text to require addGuestStudents(int) (preferred), or alternatively change the UML and solution to accept a String and specify parsing behavior. Ensure all examples and task descriptions use the same signature (addGuestStudents(int)).

issues.description: The problem description inconsistently specifies the parameter type for addGuestStudents: one place in the task text declares addGuestStudents(String) (lines 49-51), while the UML and the reference implementation use addGuestStudents(int) (UML lines 71-73, solution implementation lines 90-92). This mismatch can confuse students about the expected method signature and lead them to implement the wrong parameter type.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method signature across all artifacts. Prefer using addGuestStudents(int) (update the problem text to state addGuestStudents(int) on lines 49-51) so it matches the UML and the solution implementation; alternatively, if a String parameter is intended, update the UML, template, and solution to use addGuestStudents(String).
